description: This file defines a test grain class `TransactionCommitterTestGrain` for Orleans, implementing the `ITransactionCommitterTestGrain` interface. It manages transaction commit operations using an injected `ITransactionCommitter` and handles logging. The class overrides activation behavior to initialize logging and provides a method to execute commit operations.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class for managing transaction commit operations within Orleans, utilizing logging and transaction committer dependencies.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the grain activation method to initialize the logger with a context-specific name.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Executes the commit operation by invoking the committer's OnCommit method.
